raw_segments.text: Soon, the two ships diverged their wakes, and long as the strange vessel was in view,
she was seen to yaw hither and thither at every dark spot, however small on the sea.
This way and that her yards were swung round, starboard and larboard she continued to tack,
now she beat against a head sea, and again it pushed her before it, while all the while
her masts and yards were thickly clustered with men as three tall cherry trees when the
boys are cherrying among the boughs.
